About these terms

These terms apply to the Wavy desktop app and this project website, maintained through csgdV2/WavyMusic. By using them, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, stop using the app and website.

Accounts and integrations

The current Wavy app has no account or login system. Local data and requests to third-party services are described in the Privacy Policy.

Google, YouTube, Discord, GitHub, and lyrics providers are independent third parties. Their services, terms, policies, and technical availability can change. A feature may become unavailable or require a later app update.

Downloads, updates, and your library

Official project downloads are linked from GitHub Releases. Check the release description for its supported Windows version and installation requirements. A website feature description may refer to a version newer than the currently published release.

Updates can change features or data formats. Keep backups of playlists or other local files that matter to you. Local playlists remain on your device until you remove them.

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the project maintainers are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, loss of data, or disruption arising from use of Wavy, its website, or third-party integrations. This does not exclude liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, and does not limit mandatory consumer rights.

Stopping use and future changes

You can stop using Wavy at any time and remove local data using the data deletion instructions. Removing the program alone may not remove its app-data folder.

These terms may change with the project. Updated terms will be published here with a revised date. If you do not agree to a later change, stop using the affected app or website.

Contact

For support or questions about these terms, contact the project through GitHub Issues. Do not post credentials or other private account information in public issues.
